geometry.geometry_revision: Unchanged source 28/50/76 neutral geometry; intact PET, rigid square perimeters and free roof interiors

frames.fea_frame: Origin lower perimeter center; Z upwards; source rotated +90 degrees about X and uniformly scaled from 250-unit width to 0.03 m
frames.isaac_frame: Same orientation plus recorded vertical display offset
frames.transform_fea_to_isaac: Identity rotation and scale; translation [0,0,offset] in saved calculation
frames.positive_angle_direction: Right-hand relative frame rotation vector, not independent Euler angles

material.model: Finite-rotation Green membrane strain / plane-stress StVK plus discrete hinges; uncalibrated
material.assumptions: User thicknesses; unmeasured elastic moduli, perfectly bonded isotropic PLA/PET. Material reference uses physical PET bending and zero extra crease coupling. PET pre-creasing/plasticity uncalibrated.
material.sensitivity_note: Separate one-at-a-time strip, panel bending and membrane experiments are fully recorded; no soft experiment promoted to actual PLA/PET

mesh.element_type: Triangular membrane with discrete bending hinges and explicit PET-only borders
mesh.mesh_revision: Boundary subdivision 1-5; independent uniform interior 0-2; size guard
mesh.convergence_summary: Boundary 3, interior 0->1 response changes ~8.7/17.4/8.0 percent for compression/bend/twist; 5% gate failed

boundary_conditions: Static upper perimeter frame fixed; lower frame and shell free under applied loads
Roof interiors deform; only square perimeters rigid
No prescribed joint angle in winch or cable-force experiments
Drop: both frames dynamic; four frictionless compliant normal foot contacts
loads: Existing independent constant-tension mode retained, 12 pull-only strands
Elastic winch: T=min(k*max(L-L0,0),force_cap), inactive cables have T=0; potential is the exact integral of this law
Winch pull shortens active cable rest lengths relative to neutral; unselected cables slack, no implied preload or physical guide routing
Optional lower-frame resultant force distributed over its perimeter
70 mm foot-first drop; assumed 30 g upper / 20 g lower assembly, shell mass included, no payload, unloaded cables

solver.software: Project NumPy/SciPy/Torch sparse nonlinear shell + IPC Toolkit 1.6.0 rendered in Isaac
solver.version: Implementation commit and source-file hashes in linked run manifest
solver.analysis_type: Quasistatic load continuation; separate implicit backward-Euler drop diagnostic
solver.notes: Actual elastic/cable/contact energy gradients; Gauss-Newton search tangent. Midsurface barrier and conservative curved-frame CCD, NOT finite-thickness contact. Impact numerical stopping target 1e-6; physical residual rejection remains 3e-5.

limitations: Full folding motion is not reproduced
Actual PET seam connectivity and cable guides unconfirmed
Creased-film plasticity, hysteresis, bonds and print anisotropy uncalibrated
Midsurface contact has no laminate thickness clearance, friction or cable contact
Drop result window/stop reason in metrics; no strength or survival verdict

review.notes: Local only; controls tested in reopened USD; no external publication
